limitations: Restricted to a shifted chi-square-one auxiliary observable with independent additive Gaussian high-fidelity noise.
Fixed two-fidelity nested sampling, same-sample unregularized intercept-and-slope fit, exact arithmetic.
The Dirichlet inverse moment is given as an exact simplex expectation rather than an elementary closed form.
Older equivalent specialized regression/two-phase-sampling results could exist; priority remains open.
No claim of generic pilot reuse unbiasedness or computational-cost optimality.
scientific_integrity: The analytic proof establishes fixed-n integrability, the sharp slope-moment and finite-variance cutoffs, the exact finite-variance identity and gain condition. Finite verifier checks supplement rather than prove the universal statements. The same estimator structure is classical; novelty is claimed only for the specified exact Gaussian-quadratic finite-sample law.
title: A five-pair variance threshold for reused Gaussian-quadratic control variates
